name: canto
description: Search, read and tidy your Canto meeting notes and transcripts, and send Canto's notetaker to a call.

interface.longDescription: Canto records your meetings, in the room or on Teams, Google Meet and Zoom, and turns them into speaker-labelled transcripts and notes with decisions, action items and open questions. Ask what was decided last week and ChatGPT searches every note you can see, including ones shared with you, and cites the recording. Read a note in full, page through the transcript, list what you recorded on a day or in a folder, see the next two days of meetings with join links, and send the notetaker to a call by pasting its link. Two light write actions: update a note's title, tags or your own notes, and send the notetaker. The AI summary is never changed and nothing can be deleted or shared. Access is per user and revocable from Canto settings.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about pricing in my recent meetings?
What meetings do I have today, and is the notetaker booked?
Summarise yesterday's standup from the transcript
